items.rationale: Rainwater entering from outside is inundation under §2.5, not escape of water under §2.4.2. No scheduled further-natural-hazards cover is shown, so §3.6.2(b) bars the labour; if cover were confirmed, 12 hours at €85 gross would total €1,020.
Section 3.6.2(f) bars journey charges for uninsured inundation. If flood cover were confirmed, this first listed journey could qualify under §7.1.7(g) at the €79 gross reference amount.
Section 3.6.2(d) bars equipment charges for uninsured inundation. Even if flood cover were confirmed, §§4.3(d) and 5.2.2 exclude separate reimbursement for a pump procured to perform the extraction.
Section 3.6.2(d) bars this charge, and §5.2.2 independently treats the pump as part of the extraction measure rather than as a separately payable item.

Pumping is a mitigation measure under §5.2.2, but §§3.6.2(d) and 5.1 bar it without scheduled flood cover. If cover were confirmed, €450 gross is an allowance for the complete operation, including labour and pump use.
Section 3.6.2(c) bars materials for uninsured inundation. If flood cover were confirmed, §7.1.7(c) would allow about €125 gross for standard materials actually installed in the affected circuits.

items.description: Renew boiler, flue and storage tank
items.rationale: The fixed heating system is insured property under §4.2.2, but §3.6.2(a) bars replacement because no flood cover is shown. If cover were confirmed, §§7.1.1(c) and 7.1.9 would allow about €10,500 gross for like-for-like renewal, excluding separately billed pipe alterations and disposal.

items.description: Adapt supply pipework to replacement boiler
items.rationale: Section 3.6.2(a) expressly bars adaptation work for uninsured inundation. If flood cover were confirmed, §7.1.7(d) would allow about €550 gross for necessary alterations to the adjoining connections.

Section 3.6.2(e) bars removal and disposal for uninsured inundation. If flood cover were confirmed, §5.2.1 would allow about €350 gross for hauling away and disposing of the unusable system, subject to the scheduled limit.

Section 3.6.2(f) bars the charge even if the trip was necessary. Even if flood cover were confirmed, §§7.1.7(g) and 7.1.8(d) allow only one journey for the event across both trades, so the second listed journey is not separately payable.
